viv: quick note— after yesterday's auth change some customers reported transient 429s tied to delegated keys. I dug into traces.
oscar: repro steps?
viv: client->edge->auth-exchange returns 200 but quota sees request as anonymous because `X-Project-Attr` was stripped earlier in the path.
mei: that was intentional when we tightened header hygiene, but quota needs a trusted internal header.
sre-zoe: mitigation idea: have auth-exchange emit a signed internal header `X-RW-Attr` (proj=<id>;src=exchange;ttl=30;sig=<hmac>) and ensure edge-router strips it before client response.
oscar: agree, signing avoids trusting raw headers. need key rotation story. auth-exchange can reuse the signing KMS key used for session cookies.
mei: add metrics: `auth.exchange.attr_emitted` and `quota.attribution.missing`. Dashboard: missing_ratio, emitted_count, and a reconciliation backfill job status. Alert if missing_ratio > 1% for 10m.
sre-zoe: rollout: gate behind ff `auth.emit_attr_v1`. Canary cluster A for 2h, then 5% traffic for 6h, then 100% after 24h if stable. Also sample 100% of fallback events for 1h then 0.5% afterwards.
viv: console UX: show a subtle banner for affected orgs: "Temporary quota attribution issues for delegated keys. We're patching; contact support if you see persistent rate errors."
oscar: deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-exchange v6.4 -> cluster-a (by oscar)
sre-zoe: include `trace_id` in logs and wire the header into billing reconciler so we can backfill for recent windows.
mei: filed GH: https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/5277 with header spec + strip policy.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: auth-exchange v6.4 -> cluster-a
viv: will monitor metrics for next 3h and post updates. Thanks all.
